notes: Title on the page and images. Safe to change anytime.
Team name, shown under the title. Safe to change anytime.
Default display language: Indonesia or English. Members can still switch on their own phone. Safe to change anytime.
First draw day, format 2026-11-09. Required. Do not change once running.
Days with a draw, separated by commas. Changing this changes all results (Option 1).
Time seat numbers open, format 07:00, in the Time Zone below. Safe to change anytime.
Draw time zone for all members: Asia/Jakarta (WIB), Asia/Makassar (WITA), Asia/Jayapura (WIT), any other zone, or +7. Empty = WIB. Safe to change anytime.
Number of numbered seats, at least the number of members. Changing this changes all results (Option 1).
Manual = press Draw number. Automatic = shown right at draw time. Safe to change anytime.
Members excluded from shuffling, format Name: number, separated by commas (e.g. Vina: 3). Empty = everyone is shuffled. Changing this changes all results (Option 1).
Secret shuffle text, replace with your own random text. Option 1 only (Option 2 makes its own). Do not change once running.
